How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NDMC Executive Engineer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NDMC Executive Engineer (Civil) posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the NDMC Executive Engineer (Civil) recruitment is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Executive Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Executive Engineer (Civil) position by the New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC).

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the Executive Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university or equivalent, along with 5 years of experience in Civil Engineering works.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Executive Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Executive Engineer (Civil) post is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Executive Engineer (Civil) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 per month, corresponding to Level 11 in the revised 7th CPC pay matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the NDMC Executive Engineer (Civil) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NDMC Executive Engineer (Civil) posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NDMC Executive Engineer (Civil) recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Executive Engineer (Civil) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Eligibility Check followed by Deputation Appointment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is EN 24/82.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) located?
faq.answer: The New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110001.
